Security Policy
===============

Reporting a Vulnerability
- Please report security issues privately via GitHub Security Advisories for this repository, or email the maintainer if listed in the repository metadata.
- Do not open public issues for security reports. We will coordinate a fix and disclosure timeline.

Supported Versions
- Active development happens on `main`. We generally address security issues on `main` and may backport at the maintainer's discretion.

Notes
- This project uses Dependabot to surface known vulnerable dependencies where applicable. See the repository Security tab and PRs opened by Dependabot for details.
